programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 GKA Kite-Surf season once again opens in the iconic point break of Cape Verde’s Sal Island, with the title race set to be tighter than ever as it plays out over a scheduled five globe-trotting stops. A full line-up of 24 men and an expanding roster of women, with 18 athletes, from a total of 13 countries around the world are set to battle for glory in the intimidating right-hander of Ponta Preta that.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 1
programme.desc: In our previous episode, we visited various countries starting from Brazil. The 2025 Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazil’s north-east coast, launching its season finale. In this episode, sailors from around the world have gathered for the inaugural World Sailing Inclusion Championships, racing in one of the most stunning coastal destinations on the planet: Oman. We have a full season of sailing action ahead of us, but 2025 was also filled with spectacle from around the world. With kiteboarding now inducted to the Olympic Games since Paris 2024, watching the latest developments in the class was a ‘must’ for Inside Sailing.

programme.title: Changing Channels
programme.desc: Gerrard Gosens is set to become the first totally blind person to attempt the daunting 34+ km swim from Dover in the UK to Cape Gris-Nez in France. Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Aussie 8
programme.desc: Aussie 8 is the adventure of 3 friends who decided to climb the 8 tallest mountains in 8 Australian states in 8 days. To make this possible, they had to put together and respect a very strict timing and logistic organisation.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
programme.desc: The HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB is the final of four UTMB World Series majors in 2025, offering athletes a great opportunity to progress towards the UTMB World Series Finals. Celebrating its 6th edition with new and improved courses along with an even deeper connection to Thailands natural and cultural heritage, the event attracts over 7,200 participants, including 56 from the Asia region and an exceptional elite field across all distances.

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: UTMB KODIAK Ultra Marathon 2025
programme.desc: Two distances. One adventure. Feel the grit of the 50K, the madness of the 100K, and the shared passion that drives every runner forward. Dive into 45 minutes of raw trail energy. Relive the HOKA Kodiak Ultramarathons as if you were there.

programme.title: Ultra Gobi 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Each year, athletes from across the world gather in this remote wilderness og the Gobi desert for a test like no other. The 121-kilometer team challenge is where cooperation and strategy are everything, while the 121-kilometere solo adventure is a test for the braves. The legendary 400-kilometer race, a journey through solitude, extremes, and self-discovery. All together, they form one of the toughest endurance events on Earth.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europe’s most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Trail Menorca Cami De Cavalls 2025
programme.desc: Welcome to a new edition of the Trail Menorca Camí de Cavalls Conecta Balear. 185 kilometers tracing the edge of a millennia-old island, blessed with unique natural beauty. Enchanted trails, towering cliffs, and dreamlike beaches shape one of the most demanding routes in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: The Aviators S3
programme.desc: Sara en Anthony nemen samen met ons de checklists door en laten zien welke stappen piloten op de grond nemen om ervoor te zorgen dat alles in de lucht volgens plan verloopt.

programme.title: The Aviators S3
programme.desc: We maken kennis met de man die als geen ander ter wereld met een standaard Stearman uit 1947 vliegt en verkennen het vliegtuig waarmee gevechtspiloten worden geïntroduceerd in het landen op vliegdekschepen.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1
programme.desc: Wim Hof leert Jack hoe hij pijn onder controle kan krijgen en duikt in de ijskoude zee.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1
programme.desc: Jack maakt kennis met een man met het Sudden Artistic Output-syndroom en laat zijn creativiteit de vrije loop.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1
programme.desc: Jack maakt kennis met twee mensen die steeds maar weer in slaap vallen en komt de gevolgen van slaapgebrek te weten.

programme.title: Space Greed S1
programme.desc: Om overal te kunnen overleven, moet de mens zich aanpassen aan zijn nieuwe omgeving. Maar hoe zullen mensen veranderen om te overleven in de ruimte?

programme.title: Health Explored S2
programme.desc: Reis naar La Paz, Bolivia, om te zien hoe grote hoogte het lichaam beïnvloedt. Van wetenschap tot traditie, bezoek de heksenmarkt en leer meer over een oud Inca-medicijn tegen hoogteziekte.

programme.title: Health Explored S2
programme.desc: De extreme hoogte brengt voedingsmiddelen voort die als “superfood” worden beschouwd. Van quinoa tot bijzondere bonen en zout – we reizen van de zoutvlaktes van Uyuni terug naar La Paz om samen te werken met een meesterkok.

programme.title: Health Explored S2
programme.desc: Reis naar het hoogste meer ter wereld om te zien wat er gebeurt in dit kwetsbare ecosysteem. We sluiten ons Bolivianenavontuur af met een ceremonie ter ere van onze planeet.

programme.title: Survival Science S1
programme.desc: Nick en Laura creëren interessante tests om de immense kracht en verbazingwekkende snelheid van grizzlyberen te onderzoeken. Ze gebruiken stuntgereedschap uit Hollywood om een aanval na te bootsen. Daarna proberen ze een wonderlijk pijlschot te recreëren dat een man redde van de dood door een berenaanval.

programme.title: Survival Science S1
programme.desc: In deze spannende aflevering komen we te weten hoe ongelukken vanuit een boom-uitzichtpunt kunnen gebeuren en hoe we ze kunnen voorkomen. Onze gastheren, het stuntteam en de crash dummies worden blootgesteld aan dynamische experimenten, waarbij ze naar de grond geslingerd worden in de naam der wetenschap.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: De lichten gaan uit en de schijnwerpers staan op de kunst van het schaduwspel. Daarna verkennen we kaarttrucs, optische illusies en sluiten af met performer en herdenker Félicien Treway.

programme.title: Rethink S1
programme.desc: We verkennen kleurschakeringen, de Body Transfer-illusie, de Leugenaarsparadox en video. Zijn bewegende beelden eigenlijk een illusie?

programme.title: DRONERS S1
programme.desc: DRONERS volgt raceauto's, vliegt over bergen heen en verkent verlaten gebouwen tijdens een waar avontuur om erachter te komen wat er echt voor nodig is om een freestyle piloot te worden.

programme.title: DRONERS S1
programme.desc: DRONERS ontdekt hoe de technologische vooruitgang, gedreven door de FPV-community, de wereld vooruitbrengt in deze snelle community.

programme.title: DRONERS S1

programme.title: Battle Factory S1

programme.desc: Wanneer een met staal beklede romp wordt uitgerust met bedieningselementen aan de binnenkant en rupsbanden aan de buitenkant, ontstaat de Viking BVS10: een gepantserd amfibisch personeelsvoertuig dat troepen naar en uit elk gevechtsgebied kan vervoeren, zelfs als het daarvoor door sneeuw, zand of water moet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1
programme.sub-title: An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft
programme.desc: Wanneer een met staal beklede romp wordt uitgerust met bedieningselementen aan de binnenkant en rupsbanden aan de buitenkant, ontstaat de Viking BVS10: een gepantserd amfibisch personeelsvoertuig dat troepen naar en uit elk gevechtsgebied kan vervoeren, zelfs als het daarvoor door sneeuw, zand of water moet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1
programme.sub-title: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
programme.desc: Wanneer een reeks delicate, sneeuwvlokvormige vellen aramide op elkaar worden geperst, vormen ze een hoofddeksel dat comfortabel genoeg is om in oorlogstijd te dragen en sterk genoeg om een kogel te weerstaan.

programme.title: Digits S1
programme.desc: Muller neemt de kijkers mee naar de kern van het internet en onthult het allereerste bericht dat werd verzonden door UCLA-professor Leonard Kleinrock. Hij laat zien hoe de ontwikkelaars van het internet, Vint Cerf en Bob Kahn, een gemeenschappelijke programeertaal bedachten.

programme.title: Power & S2
programme.desc: Tabb Firschau is een cameraman en mede-oprichter van Freefly systemen om camerastabilisators en onbemande vliegtuigen te maken die gebruiksvriendelijk zijn.

programme.title: Power & S2
programme.desc: Shane Chen is uitvinder. Of, in zijn eigen woorden: een "denker" - een gast die zijn brood verdient door gekke creaties te maken van bestaande mechanismen.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1
programme.desc: Wat kan de technologische vooruitgang betekenen voor de positie van de mens bij het maken van muziek?

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Brad en Nathan bouwen een brandweertrainingsunit, Dave werkt aan attracties en Dan en Francis tillen een enorme graafmachine uit een bouwput.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1
programme.desc: Leerling Eden neemt haar eerste grote lift voor haar rekening. Dan en Francis werken aan een waterkrachtcentrale, Brad en Nathan bouwen een portaalkraan, en J.P. verplaatst stalen balken.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1
programme.desc: Ingenieur en avonturier Rob Bell onderzoekt vier achtbanen in Europa en Amerika die psycholische trucjes gebruiken om de rit nóg meer spanning te geven.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1
programme.desc: Ingenieur en avonturier Rob Bell onderzoekt vier achtbanen in Europa en Amerika die plezier mixen met spanning.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1
programme.desc: Ingenieur en avonturier Rob Bell komt erachter wat ervoor nodig is om de volgende generatie achtbanen te ontwerpen en bouwen.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: In de allereerste Europese fabriek van Kellogg’s, gebouwd in de jaren 1930 in Trafford Park, Manchester, ontmoeten we de mensen die maïs tot vlokken verwerken en de rijst opblazen, de proevers die alles testen, en de robots en hightechmachines die dag en nacht zorgen dat de dozen blijven rollen.

programme.title: More Curious? S1
programme.sub-title: What do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?
programme.desc: Duik in de wetenschap achter fossielen en verken wat moderne sportscholen te bieden hebben. Wat is inductiekoken precies? En wat hebben karate en kickboksen met elkaar gemeen?

programme.title: More Curious? S1
programme.sub-title: What is the Moon made of?
programme.desc: Wat is melk? Waaruit bestaat de maan? Hoe worden potloden gemaakt? Ontdek daarnaast alles over achtbanen, linialen, zeilboten, slangen en meer in deze aflevering van Meer Nieuwsgierig.

programme.title: More Curious? S1
programme.desc: Leer meer over jachten, de seizoenen en sushi, en ontdek daarnaast de krijgskunst taekwondo. Bekijk de verwoesting die een tsunami kan aanrichten en luister naar de speelse én mysterieuze klanken van een viool.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1
programme.desc: Een gebouw uit 1960 bomvol asbest in de drukke stad Londen moet worden vernietigd om ruimte te maken voor een nieuw hotel.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1
programme.desc: Brendan Moar kijkt terug op de meest interessante en dramatische momenten die hij heeft meegemaakt als The Demolition Man.

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1
programme.desc: Of de strijd nu te land, ter zee of in de lucht is, elke oorlogsmachine heeft vermogen nodig. Bij luchtgevechten op 15 kilometer hoogte of enorme ladingen tillen is PK de beslissende factor.

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1
programme.desc: Snelle informatie is belangrijk voor de aanval en verdediging. Waar de slag ook gevoerd wordt, het is essentieel de vijand eerder te zien dat diegene jou ziet.

programme.title: Combat Countdown S1
programme.desc: De verrassingsfactor is van groot belang in een oorlogssituatie. Door een tegenstander te overrompelen, kun je het gevecht winnen voordat het begonnen is. In deze aflevering een top tien van de oorlogsmachines in elke wapenklasse met het grootste verrassingseffect.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1
programme.desc: Ultimate Explosions brengt de meeslepende verhalen van explosies die wereldwijd voelbaar waren.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1
programme.desc: John McLain (Bruce Willis) hangt aan de buitenkant van een gebouw. De enige manier om zichzelf te redden is door het glas te schieten om zichzelf in veiligheid te brengen. Met dezelfde beretta 92 schieten wij op het glas van het kantoor om te zien of onze gastheer er doorheen kan breken.

programme.title: Science of Sound S1
programme.desc: Marty Music spreekt met Steve Hogan, hoofd van het Music Genome Project bij Pandora, over hoe muziekanalisten en Kunstmatige Intelligentie precies weten wat we willen horen.

programme.desc: Thom ontmoet een man die beweert de snelste mens op aarde te zijn en een man die een vorm van echolocatie gebruikt om te zien hoe de wereld om hem heen geluid gebruikt.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S1
programme.desc: Thom vindt een man die een grotere rechte- dan linkerarm heeft en geeft een andere man de ultieme opdracht: een brand blussen met het water dat hij in zijn maag heeft.

programme.title: Into the Blue (2005)
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Into The Blue 2: The Reef (2025)
programme.desc: Sebastion and Dani, owners of a small diving company in Hawaii, are excited when hired by jet-setters offering big money for help in finding a sunken treasure. But the young pair soon find that the job will test their diving – and survival - skills!

programme.title: The Package (1989)
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: No Way Out (1987)
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: Body Of Evidence (2023)
programme.desc: After a night of unbridled passion, Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) finds herself on trial for murder. Now it's up to her attorney (Willem Dafoe) to prove her innocence...but the road to the truth may prove to have as many curves as his seductive client!

programme.title: The Hot Spot (1990)
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Red Corner (2023)
programme.desc: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

programme.title: Invasion U.S.A. (1985)
programme.desc: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

programme.title: The Octagon (1980)
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Firewalker (1986)
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade (1983)
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)

programme.title: Rollerball (2002)
programme.desc: Chris Klein, LL Cool J, and Rebecca Romijn-Stamos star in this high-octane thriller as the hottest team in the brutal sport Rollerball. When they discover the league's owner (Jean Reno) will do anything for ratings, they plan to take down the sport!

programme.title: Tank Girl (2023)
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell, "The Passage") controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty, "Cadillac Man") and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: RoboCop (1987)
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop 2 (1990)
programme.desc: In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

programme.title: RoboCop 3 (1993)
programme.desc: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

programme.title: Mad Max (2023)
programme.desc: In the ravaged near-future, a brutal motorcycle gang rules the road, terrorizing innocent civilians. But they underestimate one cop: Max (Mel Gibson). When the bikers brutalize Max's family, they send him into a mad frenzy and a need for revenge!

programme.title: American Ninja (1985)

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation (1987)
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt (1989)
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation (1990)
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Hoodlum (2022)
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, the black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. Three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
programme.desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana
programme.desc: Dharam (Dharmendra) and Gajodhar (Bobby Deol) are a father-son con team skilled in tricking their unsuspecting fellow Indians. When a nonresident Indian, Paramvir (Sunny Deol), arrives from Vancouver claiming to be Dharam's long-lost son, the duo doesn't buy it, but they admire his strength and take him into their fold. Eventually Gajodhar falls for a young woman, Saheba (Kulraj Randhawa). But when Saheba's brothers disapprove of the match, Paramvir designs a plan for Gajodhar to win her back.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.

programme.title: Shor In The City
programme.desc: A film set in Mumbai, India. The movie revolves around the lives of three men who get caught up in the chaos of the city. The first story follows two small-time crooks who attempt to pull off a heist. The second story focuses on a struggling cricketer who gets caught up in a web of corruption. The third story is about a young couple trying to find their way in the chaotic city. As their lives intersect, they must navigate through the noisy and bustling streets of Mumbai to find their own paths.

programme.title: Sarkar
programme.desc: Sarkar, an influential man, is falsely charged with the murder of an upright politician. When he is imprisoned, his son Shankar steps into his shoes as a leader to protect his father and their legacy.

programme.title: The Shaukeens
programme.desc: Bored of their mundane lives, three 60-something men, immersed in the allure of Mauritius, rekindle their youthful spirits and compete for the attention of a vivacious social media addict, Ahana.

programme.title: Patth
programme.desc: Summaries. Avi comes from a poor family and lives with his mother and sister, Nandini. He sees that Nandini has befriended a local gangster by the name of Bhullar, and quietly resents this. When Nandini is killed, Avi and two male friends, Golu and Hari, decide to avenge her death - by killing Bhullar.

programme.desc: The movie follows an insomniac office worker who befriends a charismatic soap salesman, and together they start an underground fight club as a way to cope with their mundane lives. As the club gains popularity, they become involved in a larger plan to undermine the consumerist society they live in.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Today's Close-Up
programme.sub-title: Chewing Well: Health Benefits for Young and Old
programme.desc: Research has found that chewing ability is closely connected to healthy lifespan and brain stimulation. At the same time, data suggests there has been a decline in chewing strength across Japan, a trend that experts attribute to changes in the modern diet, among other factors. The result has been a greater prevalence of underdeveloped jaws in children, and increased frailty and health problems in older adults. We spoke with experts, who explained how consistent oral training and mindful eating can boost our focus and ensure a longer and healthier life. Guest: Teruyama Yuko (Dentist and Doctor of Dental Science)

programme.title: NEWSROOM TOKYO
programme.desc: NEWSROOM TOKYO dives deeper into the day's news with insight and analysis, from the perspective of Japan and the rest of Asia. We put a spotlight on what you need to know to understand the issues.

programme.title: Direct Talk
programme.sub-title: The Beauty and Art of Watchmaking: Makihara Daizoh / Watchmaker
programme.desc: Makihara Daizoh is drawing attention from around the world for crafting timepieces that embody a Japanese aesthetic. He talks about the appeal of analog watchmaking in the digital age.

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: The number of tornadoes is surging in the US - the world's hotspot. What's driving the rise? We met the scientists who are uncovering their mechanisms and using new technology to save lives.

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
programme.desc: A group of anglers stand in a fast-moving, undulating river at the foot of a rugged cliff. They use "drifting mosquito hooks" to fish for a summer delicacy that was a favorite of the Edo townspeople. *"Fly-fishing" from the series "One Thousand Pictures of the Ocean" (c.1833) by Katsushika Hokusai

programme.title: Medical Frontiers
programme.sub-title: Glaucoma: The Fight to Prevent Blindness
programme.desc: Glaucoma, which can lead to blindness, often shows no symptoms in the early stages. We feature the latest efforts to restore the optic nerve, including new surgical techniques and gene therapy.

programme.title: Gunmachan (Ep. 6)
programme.desc: Join Gunmachan and friends for playful adventures full of laughter and curiosity, and explore the charm of Gunma Prefecture's traditions, culture, and specialties.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Time and Tide
programme.desc: Wakayama Castle was a crucial castle for Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu who both guided Japan to peace. Its location south of the economic center of Osaka near the Pacific Ocean was strategic.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode introduces words associated with water. Water has long been regarded as plentiful and accessible in Japan. It is deeply embedded in Japanese culture and is even used to describe human relationships and life itself. Poet, literary translator and long-time Japan resident Peter MacMillan guides us through these unique words and the culture behind them.

programme.title: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: The Onabare festival is a 300-year-old folk cultural property in Kami, Kochi Prefecture. A portable shrine is paraded through the streets, with dancing and other performances taking place along the way. The highlight is nerikomi, which involves the careful wielding of a long, heavy pole. We see a first-timer and others battling through a tough training process, as they prepare to attempt a remarkable feat of skill and strength that is a key feature of this local matsuri tradition.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: tiny desk concerts JAPAN
programme.desc: "New" Traditional Japanese Music: Piano, Shamisen, and Electronic Sounds Since debuting with her 1976 album JAPANESE GIRL, Yano Akiko has been a trailblazer in blending Japanese culture with her unique musical style, including collaborations with Yellow Magic Orchestra. Agatsuma Hiromitsu, a renowned shamisen virtuoso, has been redefining "tradition and innovation" through performances that transcend genres and borders. The two artists come together for yano et agatsuma and take on tiny desk concerts JAPAN! Joined by Fukasawa Hideyuki on synthesizer, the trio introduces the world to a new type of Japanese music rooted in folk traditions and classic melodies.

programme.title: BOSAI: Science that Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: In this episode, we look at Japan's efforts to improve tsunami evacuation, from overcoming "normalcy bias" that causes people to underestimate risk, to the installation of coastal evacuation towers.

programme.title: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN
programme.desc: Yamagata Prefecture / Minagawa Akira (Designer) To make a "dantsu" carpet, everything from yarn-making to weaving is done by hand. Minagawa experiences the deep allure of handmade goods.

programme.title: The Wind Phone
programme.sub-title: The Phone of the Wind: Whispers to Lost Families
programme.desc: "Hello. If you're out there, please listen to me." On a hill overlooking the ocean in Otsuchi Town in northeastern Japan is a phone booth known as the "Telephone of the Wind." It is connected to nowhere, but people come to "call" family members lost during the tsunami of the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake. Many visit the phone booth including a mother and 3 children who have lost their father. This documentary looks at the unique role that this phone is playing in helping the grieving process of many. Awards: Grand Prix, 36th International URTI Grand Prix for Author's Documentary (2017) Highly Commended, 21st Asian Television Awards (2016)

programme.desc: Kata-yuzen is a Kyoto yuzen dyeing method that sometimes requires as many as 100 stencils to complete a bolt of kimono fabric. The development of this method saved dyers much time and enabled mass production. The most skill-intensive task is the carving of the washi paper to create the stencils. The elaborate designs and sharp lines that are difficult to attain by hand are captivating. Discover how the Kata-yuzen techniques were refined through the Kyotoites passionate pursuit of stunning kimono.

programme.desc: Shaun, the world's most famous and favourite sheep, is back for more laugh out loud adventures on Mossy Bottom Farm. Season 4, episodes 28-30.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep - Episodes from Season 5 (2024)
programme.desc: Shaun and the gang are back! This time they’re joined by a multitude of visitors including lazy farmhands and rock stars, as well as troublesome moles and hedgehogs in need of a good night’s sleep. Season 5, episodes 18 - 20.

programme.title: Pop Paper City - Episodes from Season 1 (2024)
programme.desc: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where a group of unique paper friends live. Together they use craft to solve challenges and complete their adventures. Season 1, episodes 23 & 24.

programme.title: Pop Paper City - Episodes from Season 1 (2024)
programme.desc: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where a group of unique paper friends live. Together they use craft to solve challenges and complete their adventures. Season 1, episodes 25 & 26.

programme.title: Pop Paper City - Episodes from Season 1 (2024)
programme.desc: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where a group of unique paper friends live. Together they use craft to solve challenges and complete their adventures. Season 1, episodes 27 & 28.

programme.title: Pop Paper City - Episodes from Season 1 (2024)
programme.desc: Pop Paper City is the capital of a captivating paper world where a group of unique paper friends live. Together they use craft to solve challenges and complete their adventures. Season 1, episodes 29 & 30.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit - A Matter of Loaf & Death (2024)
programme.desc: Wallace and Gromit have opened a new bakery business but a deadly murderer is targeting all the bakers in town. Wallace, meanwhile, finds true love with Piella Bakewell. Can Gromit uncover the Cereal Killer’s identity before it’s too late?

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep - Episodes from Season 1 (2024)
programme.desc: Peace in the valley turns to mayhem in the meadow as Shaun leads his flock into all sorts of scrapes and scraps, running rings around sheepdog Bitzer when the Farmer's back is turned. Season 1, episodes 37-39.

programme.title: Waqt Ki Awaz (1988)
programme.desc: Lata runs away from home in order to avoid an arranged marriage fixed by her father. She chances upon and falls in love with a truck driver named Vishwa but she is left devastated when he gets arrested for murdering a man.

programme.title: Kaun Sachcha Kaun Jhootha (1997)
programme.desc: Sapna, a Psychiatrist, falls in love with her patient Karan. When Karan gets normal, he asks Sapna to get married. But she disapproves of this relationship. What could be the reason?

programme.title: Baatein Kahi Ankahi
programme.desc: Watch Baatein Kahi Ankahi with RJ Anmol In An Exclusive Interview With Bollywood Stars.

programme.title: Judwaa (1997)
programme.desc: Judwaa is a story about twins Raja and Prem Malhotra who separate at birth. Years later, they reunite to defeat Ratanlal, a local gangster, who wants to destroy the Malhotra family.

programme.title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited (2006)
programme.desc: The story revolves around the lives of four guys named Gopal, Lucky, Madhav, and Laxman who all absurdly fall for the same girl. Hence, begins the hilarious race to win her heart.

programme.title: Jab We Met (2007)
programme.desc: The life of a suicidal industrialist takes a sharp turn when he meets a spirited chatterbox on a train journey in this breezy Bollywood romantic comedy.

programme.title: Ajay (1996)
programme.desc: Despite belonging to different classes and backgrounds, Ajay and Manorama fall in love. Their alliance however is despised by Manorama’s uncles and they plot to drive Ajay out of their niece's life.

programme.title: Hotel Milan (2018)
programme.desc: Vipul and his friends come up with a radical business idea for a hotel that attracts young unmarried couples and all hell breaks loose in a conservative town of Uttar Pradesh.

programme.title: Dil Ka Rishta (2003)
programme.desc: Jai unintentionally kills the husband of a woman that he loves. When she gets diagnosed with amnesia, Jai comforts her and she falls in love with him. Now, guilt-ridden Jai is left in a dilemma whether to confess his guilt or reciprocate her love.
